---
name: "✨ Improve an Analysis Phase"
about: Suggest improvements to one of the 10 analysis phases in packages/prompt-engine
title: "[Phase X] "
labels: ["phase-improvement", "good first issue"]
assignees: []
---

## Which phase?
Phase number and name (e.g. Phase 4: DB Migrations)

## What's missing or wrong?
What does the current phase output poorly or miss entirely?

## Proposed improvement
How should the prompt change? What should the output include?

## Example
(Optional) Paste an example of a ticket where the current phase fails, and what better output would look like.

> **Contributing tip:** The phase file is at `packages/prompt-engine/src/phases/0X-name.ts`.
> Edit the prompt inside `runPhase()` and open a PR. No web app knowledge needed.
